create_kv_cache_spec: create KV cache specs from a VLLM configuration by extracting attention layer cache requirements
init_attention_backend: initialize attention backends and groups from a KV cache configuration for a given device
init_kv_cache: allocate and reshape KV cache tensors then bind them to the forward context

build_attn_metadata: build attention metadata for all KV cache groups from sequence and block table information
